song.name: Crimson Covenant
song.plot: In the high celestial spires of Auroria, Seer Acheron studies forbidden cosmic frequencies. He detects the slumbering entity Nyktoros and discovers blueprints for siphoning void energy into mortal flesh.
song.analysis: The original is a generic vampire ballad ("Ancient beings... eyes like moons... walking the earth"). The reworked version anchors it to Acheron's specific origin: cast down from Auroria's spires, discovering Nyktoros's void-blueprints, and founding the Crimson Covenant. Preserves the Suno meter (7-8 syllables per line) and the 5-verse structure. Suggested song direction: regal, cosmic, tragic — deep orchestral strings, slow epic drums, dark choir.

section.name: Verse 1
section.original: From the mists of time, they emerged Ancient beings, their power surged Eyes like moons, a chilling sight In the darkness, they found their might
section.reworked: From high Aurorian spires, cast down A fallen Seer without a crown With silver eyes that pierce the night He sought the dark abyssal light

section.name: Chorus

section.reworked: Crimson Covenant, born of grace Exiled in time and mortal space Bound by the Thirst, a primordial creed Forging a dark celestial seed
